name: Weather
description: Check the current weather for any city (needs internet).

changelog.1.1.0: Three-day forecast, Celsius/Fahrenheit, and the last forecast shows when you are offline.
changelog.1.1.1: Now says what it can do (permissions: shown before you install, enforced while it runs), is listed in the new categories, and handles Ctrl+C and command-line arguments cleanly.
